questions.stem: Dr. Aman is the newly appointed director of a national agency responsible for coordinating disaster management plans at the country's level. Recently, the country has witnessed an upsurge in natural disasters, including floods and earthquakes. As a part of his role, Dr. Aman is working with various stakeholders to ensure seamless coordination during any disaster to minimize loss of life and property. Which of the following entities is responsible for the overall coordination of the disaster management plan at the national level for natural disasters?
